day1_night_start.text: *I arrived home. While the ramen water boiled, I took the transfer papers out of my bag.*

day1_night_home_2.text: *The faces of the people I met today come back to me one by one.*

day1_night_home_3.text: *They were all good people. It didn't take long for that sentence to come to mind. The smell of ramen slowly spread through the room.*

day1_night_phone_2.text: *The group chat from my old school. Under the message I sent this morning -- 'I transferred here, hope everyone's doing well~' -- there is a single gray checkmark.*

day1_night_phone_4.text: *I also sent a personal message to my close friend Minsu. 'Hey Minsu, I transferred! This school is huge' -- still no reply.*

day1_night_phone_5.text: *I opened the message input box, then closed it. I had nothing to send.*

day1_night_sea_2.text: What do you want in your lunchbox tomorrow?

day1_night_sea_reply_1.text: Ooh nice! Look forward to it tomorrow <3

day1_night_sea_reply_2.text: Lol okay~ don't be surprised tomorrow!

day1_night_sleep_1.text: *I lie in bed and stare at the ceiling.*

day1_night_sleep_2.text: *On the desk, the empty chocolate milk carton Se-a gave me, the photo Yuna gave me, and Riin's teabag wrapper are lined up side by side.*

day1_night_sleep_3.text: *I close my eyes. The pillow grew heavy sooner than I expected.*

day1_night_sleep_4.text: *Just before I fell asleep, a stain on the ceiling caught my eye. Three short lines, and a mark curving to the left.*

day1_night_sleep_5.text: *I blinked once, and it went back to being just a stain. I closed my eyes.*

day1_night_key_1.text: *Half-asleep, I heard a short metallic sound from the front door. Click. Once.*

day1_night_key_2.text: *...Was it a dream? I half-opened my eyes. Darkness. Couldn't see a thing. The door was still closed.*

day1_night_key_3.text: *I checked the clock. 2:14 AM. The entryway sensor light turns on for the briefest moment, then goes out.*
